[[Soulwhisper's Guardian]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Soulwhisper, Elder Guardian]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Gyala Hatchery (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Restoration Magic]])
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
Soulwhisper's Guardian shares the same [[skin]] as a [[Straw Effigy]] [[dye]]d green.
